name: Impact frame
description: A manga impact frame: the speaker in two-tone ink with outlines, speed lines bursting behind the head, and a huge word across the chest over a black band with rushing lines. It flips to negative on the hits and shakes a little at the start.
when: On the one big hit of a video: a reveal, a punchline, a single loud word.
needs: the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
the ink drawing (person-ink.webm, made in the steps)
